sources.name: OS Places API Overview
sources.role: authoritative address lifecycle, geocoding and service-scope contract
verified_facts: OS Places API exposes AddressBase Premium and Islands address records for capture, verification, geocoding and reverse geocoding, with daily updates.
semantic_limits: An address lookup, UPRN or returned coordinate is not an exact HMLR parcel polygon or a terrain measurement.

sources.name: OS Places API Technical Specification
verified_facts: The specification defines Find, Postcode, UPRN, Nearest, BBOX, Radius and Polygon request types.
semantic_limits: Endpoint availability and schema validity do not prove complete pagination, exact geometry or measurement truth.

sources.name: OS Places API Find Endpoint
sources.role: free-text address match, score, paging and bbox contract
verified_facts: Find performs free-text matching with match thresholds, paging controls and an optional British National Grid bounding box.
semantic_limits: A high address match score is address-string evidence, not parcel-boundary or height confidence.

sources.name: OS Places API Postcode Endpoint
sources.role: postcode result-set, paging and dataset-selection contract
verified_facts: Postcode searches return matching DPA or LPI address records with a maximum page size of 100 and an offset.
semantic_limits: One postcode can cover multiple properties; a returned page is not an exact parcel selection or complete source receipt.

sources.name: OS Places API UPRN Endpoint
verified_facts: The endpoint retrieves matched address records for a valid UPRN and supports several output coordinate reference systems.
semantic_limits: A UPRN identifies an addressable location; it does not by itself identify an HMLR legal extent or ODN elevation.

sources.name: OS Places API Nearest Endpoint
sources.role: nearest-address point, radius and distance-order contract
verified_facts: Nearest searches from a coordinate pair within an optional radius of up to 1,000 metres and returns closest addresses.
semantic_limits: Nearest-neighbour selection is not point-in-polygon containment and coordinate decimal precision is not positional accuracy.

sources.name: OS Places API BBOX Endpoint
sources.role: bounding-box address subset and area-limit contract
verified_facts: BBOX returns addresses within a supplied bounding box whose maximum documented area is 1 square kilometre.
semantic_limits: A bounding box is a coarse spatial filter; it must not replace exact HMLR polygon containment.

sources.name: OS Places API Radius Endpoint
verified_facts: Radius returns addresses intersected by a circle around a coordinate pair, with the radius limited to 1,000 metres.
semantic_limits: Circle intersection is not evidence that an address point or parcel is wholly contained within the target polygon.

sources.name: OS Places API Polygon Endpoint
sources.role: GeoJSON polygon address subset and request-body contract
verified_facts: Polygon accepts a GeoJSON Polygon or MultiPolygon body and returns matching addresses, with optional paging and CRS controls.
semantic_limits: An address returned by a polygon query is not proof that its authoritative cadastral extent equals the query polygon.

sources.name: OS Places API Datasets
sources.role: DPA and LPI response-schema distinction contract
verified_facts: The dataset parameter selects DPA or LPI records; DPA is the default and not every property record has a DPA record.
semantic_limits: DPA and LPI are address representations and must not be silently treated as interchangeable geometry or ownership evidence.

sources.name: OS Places API Code Lists
sources.role: logical-status, classification and match-score interpretation contract
verified_facts: The code lists distinguish approved, provisional and historic logical states and describe exact, good, partial and no-match score bands.
semantic_limits: A match label or logical status is metadata and must not be converted into parcel-height confidence.

sources.name: AddressBase Premium Documentation
sources.role: address lifecycle, UPRN, cross-reference and refresh contract
verified_facts: AddressBase Premium records addresses from creation through retirement, assigns UPRNs and is refreshed on a six-week cycle.
semantic_limits: Product currency and identifier persistence do not establish exact legal boundaries or current terrain values.

sources.name: AddressBase Premium Technical Specification
sources.role: address source, format, structure and metadata contract
verified_facts: The specification covers data formats, supply, relational structure, feature types, metadata and example records for detailed lifecycle addressing.
semantic_limits: A schema-complete address record is not an HMLR polygon, and an address coordinate is not a parcel elevation sample.

sources.name: AddressBase Premium Supply and Update
sources.role: full-supply, change-only update and chunking contract
verified_facts: AddressBase Premium can be supplied as complete or area-of-interest data and as change-only updates, primarily in non-geographic chunks.
semantic_limits: A chunk, tile or change-only file is not a complete current dataset unless coverage and update lineage are reconciled.

sources.name: AddressBase Premium Structure
verified_facts: The product is organised through multiple related feature and structured record types represented by published relational models.
semantic_limits: A UPRN is not the primary key for every supplied table; joins must follow the documented model and record keys.

sources.name: AddressBase Premium Downloads
verified_facts: The downloads page supplies support files such as CSV headers, classification references and local custodian codes.
semantic_limits: Support files and schemas are not the AddressBase data distribution and cannot serve as address or parcel evidence.
